title: hooks-state
description: Output of `harness hooks show --json`: the hook modes a project sets in [harness.hooks] of .swissknifeman/config.toml, the committed carrier .swissknifeman/hooks.env as it is on disk, the legacy per-provider env.ini files that are still read, and whether the carrier differs from the one the configuration renders.

settings.description: The harness section of the project configuration, set keys only: hooks.<hook>.<key> and hooks.<hook>.providers.<provider>.<key> (the shape is the config schema of the module), and policy_profile.

hooks.description: Hook modes by hook, as the config schema defines them.

hooks_env.description: Variables of the carrier file as stored (empty when the file is missing).

legacy.description: Existing legacy <provider-dir>/*.env.ini files of the project; they are read when the carrier does not set a key, and never written.

stale.description: True when the carrier differs from the one `harness hooks sync` would write.
